title: Stop wasting afternoons clicking in CRM—let Claude build modules! #Shorts
description:
Learn how to use Claude via MCP and Zoho CRM to build custom modules and fields automatically from a single plain English prompt in seconds.

1. Connect your Claude MCP client to your Zoho CRM MCP server instance.
2. Run the prompt: 'Create a new custom module named Fleet Management with fields for Vehicle ID, Mileage, and Status.'
3. Verify the newly created module structure and layout instantly inside your CRM Setup.

API / tool used:
- name: Zoho CRM Module Customization API
- endpoint: POST /crm/v8/settings/modules
- scope: ZohoCRM.modules.ALL
- docs: Zoho CRM API Module Customization

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
